Test Case 1: Verify script returns exit code 1 when deployment has failures (pods in CrashLoopBackOff/ImagePullBackOff)

Input:
- scriptPath: repos/platform/scripts/validate-local-deployment.sh
- deploymentState: current (with unhealthy pods)

Expected Output:
- exitCode: 1
- shouldDetectFailures: true
- outputPattern: ❌ VALIDATION FAILED
- minPodsExpected: 1

Validation Logic:
Run the validation script and capture exit code. The current deployment has 2 pods not ready (devbob CrashLoopBackOff, redis ImagePullBackOff) and 1 service without endpoints (redis-replicas). Therefore, the script MUST return exit code 1 and output MUST contain '❌ VALIDATION FAILED'.
